dialogues.speaker: Mahina Nui
dialogues.text: Hello, and welcome! If you need anything, just let me know.

dialogues.speaker: Mahina Nui
dialogues.text: A chilled drink. I made it myself!

dialogues.speaker: Mahina Nui
dialogues.text: We don't have as many varieties as the Masters of the Night-Wind, but it's still refreshing and cool.

dialogues.speaker: Mahina Nui
dialogues.text: See those folks over there? We've got so many people in the hot springs, their faces are always flushed when they finally step out of the pool.

dialogues.speaker: Mahina Nui
dialogues.text: A glass of iced milk or a mint drink would hit just the spot!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I don't need anything at the moment.

dialogues.speaker: Mahina Nui
dialogues.text: Anyway, please hit me up if you ever want something cold!

dialogues.speaker: Mahina Nui
dialogues.text: Don't feel bad, here's some Mint to perk you up. Once you're ready, we can have another go!

dialogues.speaker: Mahina Nui
dialogues.text: Good show! How about a nice glass of milk to celebrate?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wouldn't be bad to drink it on a regular basis, either.

dialogues.speaker: Mahina Nui
dialogues.text: It's always sweltering around these parts, so people get dizzy fast — and that's where the Mint comes in as a pep-me-up!
